> **STOP — read this first.**
>
> Do **not** use this template to disclose a vulnerability publicly. Public issues are
> visible to everyone, including attackers, before a fix exists.
>
> Report privately via GitHub's **private vulnerability reporting** on this repository,
> or email the maintainers listed in `CODEOWNERS`. See [`SECURITY.md`](../../SECURITY.md)
> for the full process.
>
> If you have already opened this issue with sensitive details, delete it immediately and
> use the private channel instead.

## For maintainers only

Use this template to track a security report that was **already received through the
private channel**. Do not paste exploit details, private keys, or credentials here until
disclosure is agreed.

- Report reference / private advisory link:
- Reporter (or "anonymous"):
